requirements.body: The system shall expose the catalog at `GET /api/v1/network/modes` (handler: `api/internal/handlers/network.go`) returning name + description + capabilities + hardware requirements per mode.
The system shall expose `POST /api/v1/network/mode` triggering the `network_mode_switch` FlowEngine workflow at `api/internal/flowengine/workflows/network_mode_switch.go`.

When the mode-switch workflow runs, the system shall stop dependent coreapps, apply new firewall config via HAL, apply new hostapd and wpa_supplicant config via HAL, restart affected systemd services, and restart coreapps in the new boot order.
If any workflow step fails, then the system shall run compensating actions to restore the previous mode.
The system shall persist the active mode in SQLite `network_modes` table and restore it on boot.
When the mode is restored on boot, the system shall verify all required hardware is present and roll back to `offline_hotspot` if anything is missing.

When upgrading from CubeOS pre-Phase-6, the system shall map v3 modes to v4 modes: `OFFLINE` → `offline_hotspot`, `ONLINE_ETH` → `wifi_router`, `ONLINE_WIFI` → `android_tether` (USB-tether) OR `wifi_client` (direct WiFi).
When the migration cannot unambiguously map a v3 mode, the system shall prompt the operator via dashboard to choose explicitly.

acceptance.scenario: Mode switch surfaces progress via WebSocket
offline_hotspot blocks outbound internet at firewall
WiFi credentials never appear in logs or DB
Upgrade from v3 OFFLINE maps to v4 offline_hotspot
HAL uses iptables shell-outs (not nftables config files)
